== English Reflections II comparison ==
The revised LOST function sets the window at the damage segment and requires that no cards are left that can be forfeited. The battle must still be one you lost. The remaining damage cancellation, immunity to Sense for LOST, and the separate USED clause are retained. Separate Houjix or Ghhhk cards have their own publication histories.
